title: $\eta_f$ is a morphism of ring objects
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed ring ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and use the pulled-back coefficient ring objects $\Lambda_X,\Lambda_Y$ of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the strong monoidal structure on $f^*$ of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal] and the lax monoidal structure on $f_*$ of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal]. Give $f_*\Lambda_X$ the induced ring object structure of [det-def-sfb-ring-object-transport]. Then $\eta_f\colon\Lambda_Y\to f_*\Lambda_X$ of [def-sfb-eta] is a morphism of ring objects, in the sense of [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid].

proof.text: Put $F=f^*$, $G=f_*$, and $R=\Lambda_Y$. By [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], $R$ is a ring object. By [lem-sfb-finite-monoidal-adjunction], for exactly the monoidal structures in the statement the adjunction $F\dashv G$ has monoidal unit $u\colon\mathrm{id}\Rightarrow GF$. Apply clause 3 of [det-def-sfb-ring-object-transport] to this transformation and to $R$. It gives a morphism of ring objects $u_R\colon R\to GFR$, where $GFR$ has the structure obtained first by $F$ and then by $G$. These iterated structure maps are those for the composite $GF$: its tensor map is $G(\mu^F)\circ\mu^G$, and its unit map is $G(\varepsilon^F)\circ\varepsilon^G$. Thus the intermediate ring object is precisely $f_*f^*\Lambda_Y$ with the required transported structure.

source.place: sentences 1–2: the monoidal adjunction and its unit

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-alpha-ring-hom], $a=\alpha_f\colon FR\to\Lambda_X$ is a morphism of the ring objects obtained using this same strong monoidal structure on $F$. By [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal], $G$ is lax monoidal. Clause 1 of [det-def-sfb-ring-object-transport], applied to $G$ and $a$, therefore gives a morphism of ring objects $v=G(a)\colon GFR\to G\Lambda_X$. Its target structure is exactly the lax-monoidal pushforward structure specified in the statement.

source.place: sentence 3: alpha is a ring morphism and pushforward preserves it

proof.text: By [def-sfb-eta], $\eta_f=v\circ u_R$. Write $(m_R,e_R)$, $(m_T,e_T)$ and $(m_S,e_S)$ for the multiplication and unit of $R$, $T=GFR$ and $S=G\Lambda_X$. The two morphisms constructed in steps 1–2 satisfy the equations of [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid]. Hence $(vu_R)e_R=ve_T=e_S$ and $(vu_R)m_R=vm_T(u_R\otimes u_R)=m_S(v\otimes v)(u_R\otimes u_R)=m_S((vu_R)\otimes(vu_R))$. These are the two defining conditions for $\eta_f$ to be a morphism of ring objects.

source.place: last sentence: compose the two ring morphisms
